games.name: Whispering Pines
games.desc:
🔦 Welcome to Whispering Pines

Deep in the woods of the Virginia mountains lies Whispering Pines—a nature park shrouded in mystery. Urban legends have long warned of strange disappearances, but now the truth is emerging… The Spinewalker has been linked to countless missing persons cases, most vanishing after overnight trips.

Will you survive the night, or become the forest’s next victim?

🕹 Controls
LShift – Sprint
C – Crouch
LShift + C – Slide

⚔️ Run, hide, or fight back—it’s your choice.
🔊 Headphones recommended! Sound is your best tool—and your worst nightmare.
👥 Team up with friends or go solo for the ultimate challenge!
✨ Premium & Group Members get exclusive in-game bonuses!
🎮 Cross-platform support – Play anywhere!

games.name: UPDATE! Dynamic Ship Simulator III
games.desc:
Update 50 sets sail with something for everyone! Live it up aboard Superyacht Amaryllis, ride high seas on the Azerbaijan-class RO-PAX, or go back in time on the Julia Swain Paddlesteamer. Craving speed? Race the 50' & 42' Powerboats, 18' Drag Boat, or the sleek Stinger 390x. Also joining the fleet: the massive 5400 Series container ship and the Halifax-class frigate. Plus new terminals & marina at Nexo, terminal & shipyard at Ushuaia, shipyard at Ronne!

Welcome to the immense world of Dynamic Ship Simulator III! In this game, you can sail anything from a jetski all the way up to a massive Arctic-class LNG carrier. Engage in player-vs-player combat in your Visby-class Corvette, cruise around in your motorboat or transport cars in your European-class ferry. Be sure to watch for updates!

Some skins and passes can only be bought in-game!

games.name: (QOL + DESTRUCTION) NPC Builders Demo
games.desc:
You can make NPCs build whatever you want within this game.

These NPCs use a structured algorithm from the toolbox made by me in order to create builds. In other words: No, it does not use generative AI.

The NPC mimics the usage of F3X Builder tools to create objects in the world.

(Note: Turns out someone made a game called "Clone Builders" inspired by this project. I'm honestly really happy to know that someone out there thought my work was cool enough to take inspiration off of!)

games.name: Piano Keyboard v1.1
games.desc:
A piano keyboard that you can play with your computer keyboard!

Added a limit to prevent playing an unreasonable number of notes. This won't (likely) boot people who bash their keyboards, but it will boot people who use programs to play lots of notes at once.

I highly suggest using sheet music if you are struggling. Otherwise, you may find this piano difficult to play as it is adapted to fit 61 keys on a computer keyboard.

Why not take a model?
